claim: On February 12, 2025 Amazon MQ announced end of support dates of May 12, 2025 for the ActiveMQ instance types mq.t2.micro and mq.m4.large. You cannot create brokers on mq.t2.micro or mq.m4.large after March 17, 2025.
question: Which ActiveMQ instance types reached end of support in 2025, and when could you last create brokers on them?

qualifiers.scope: Amazon MQ for ActiveMQ instance types mq.t2.micro and mq.m4.large
